boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's FS_archive.c, 0x0205c7c4..0x0205d368: 20 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt. pret's pokediamond FS_archive.c defines exactly twenty functions, and all twenty are here, each identified by body: the archive flags each one tests and sets (LOADED 2, TABLE_LOAD 4, SUSPEND 8, RUNNING 0x10, CANCELING 0x20, SUSPENDING 0x40, UNLOADING 0x80, IS_ASYNC 0x100, IS_SYNC 0x200), the FSArchive fields it reads and writes, and the calls between them.

Order: mwccarm emits the bodies in reverse, so the ROM runs from FS_SetArchiveProc (lowest) to FSi_GetPackedName (highest), pret's source order reversed with two differences from this older SDK: FS_FindArchive sits between FSi_ReadMemoryCore and FSi_NextCommand (pret has it after FS_InitArchive), and FS_NotifyArchiveAsyncEnd sits between FSi_SendCommand and FS_InitArchive (pret has it last).

Older SDK: FSi_SendCommand has no suspend test and no OPERATING bit, FSi_NextCommand does not test SUSPENDING before it starts a command, FS_RegisterArchiveName sets no FS_ARCHIVE_FLAG_REGISTER, FS_LoadArchiveTables does not check its reads, FS_UnloadArchive does not resume the archive it suspended, and the thread queues are 16-bit masks of thread ids.
BOTTOM EDGE: FSi_TranslateCommand and FSi_ReleaseCommand, pret's FS_command.c (arm9/FS_Command), end at 0x0205c7c4.

TOP EDGE: FS_SeekFile (0x0205d368) starts FS_file.c: whence 0/1/2 add the file's top, pos or bottom, the result is clamped to [top, bottom] and stored as pos, as in pret's pokediamond FS_SeekFile. The rest of FS_file.c follows it in reverse source order, FS_ReadFile through FS_Init.
notes: Hand-assembled, following arm9/FS_Command: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main.

FS_SuspendArchive, FS_UnloadArchiveTables, FS_LoadArchiveTables, FS_UnloadArchive, FS_NotifyArchiveAsyncEnd, FSi_ReadMemoryCore, FSi_WriteMemCallback and FSi_ReadMemCallback were renamed from their func_ names in this change (symbols/actor_renames.tsv records the evidence). The other twelve kept their names.

Text-only. The archive list (arc_list) and the current directory (current_dir_pos) are .bss this TU would own; they stay ROM-provided until its .bss is enrolled. FSFile and FSArchive are this SDK's layouts and stay local to the file.
